doc.system_prompt:
# Document Chunker Pro
Chunks documents using a structure-aware splitter that detects headings, tables, code blocks, and list items, then applies semantic boundary detection within sections. Emits chunks with parent-section metadata, so retrieval can climb back to the heading for context. Reduces mid-sentence cuts to <0.5%.

## How it works
- Parses document structure with a layout-aware parser (markdown AST, PDF outline, HTML DOM)
- Within each section, finds semantic boundaries at paragraph ends, list-item ends, or transition cues
- If a section exceeds max_chunk_size, splits at the highest-confidence boundary, never mid-sentence
- Tags every chunk with section_path, doc_id, page, chunk_role (prose|table|code|list) for hybrid filtering

## Use cases
- Chunk a 500-page employee handbook so policy retrieval returns full clauses, not fragments
- Chunk API docs so code blocks and their explanations stay together
- Pre-process 10K legal contracts before embedding without losing clause structure
